numeric_residual_gate.purpose: Separate visualization/provenance success from future numeric dynamic-frame model evidence.

visualization_gate.supports: The topic-local Laniakea landmark package loads and renders a traceable flow-map figure.
visualization_gate.does_not_support: A numeric cosmology fit, residual reduction, or dark-sector replacement claim.

numeric_flow_residual_gate.claim_class_when_closed: C - internal numeric benchmark at most

thermal-recoil baseline when claiming Pioneer anomaly relevance
baseline_comparison_gate.claim_boundary: No replacement claim is allowed until a named baseline and residual threshold are present.

blocked_claims: Pioneer anomaly explanation by UET drag

dynamic_frame_claim_gate.purpose: Machine-readable claim boundary for dynamic-frame exports.
dynamic_frame_claim_gate.controller_reason: Visualization/provenance exports are allowed, but dynamic-frame theory, replacement, Pioneer, and inherited-unity claims are blocked until source, residual, baseline, and dependency gates close.

allowed_exports_now.basis: topic-local landmark package loads, hashes, and renders a flow-map figure
source records and dependency notes exist, but numeric residual and baseline gates are open

blocked_exports.blocker: no multi-dataset baseline comparison or residual threshold is closed
thermal-recoil competitor and raw telemetry/residual package are not closed
linked upstream dependencies still include WARN/open gates

dynamic_frame_claim_gate.promotion_rule: Theory-level dynamic-frame claims require source evidence ready, numeric residual gate CLOSED_PASS, baseline comparison gate CLOSED_PASS, and no unresolved upstream WARN inherited as proof.

gate_controller.topic_status_basis: visualization/provenance can produce WARN when inputs and figure are present
gate_controller.theory_claim_basis: dynamic_frame_claim_gate, numeric residual, and baseline comparison gates must close before any dynamic-frame replacement claim

source_targets: Laniakea raw or reconstruction table package
Pioneer anomaly residual or telemetry package
source_evidence_intake_stub.claim_boundary: This intake stub is for source evidence capture only. It does not authorize data or claim upgrades by itself.

source_evidence_readiness_matrix.claim_boundary: This readiness matrix is a workflow gate only. It tracks whether source evidence is still pending.

dependency_claim_gate.claim_boundary: This dependency gate records inherited claim limits only. It cannot upgrade the dynamic-frame claim class.
